class: Queued applications with no way to start except one Start press per row
fix: POST /api/auto-apply starts the oldest ready_to_apply row with a posting (same _run_apply primitive as Start, so every submission gate still holds; busy and empty answer honest errors) and 'Start next queued (N)' in the Applications header shows only while N > 0; the page reloads to show the run at the top. Plain form redirects for no-JavaScript.
prevention: Every queue gains its drain in an adjacent change: bulk queueing shipped with its starter.
root_cause: Bulk queueing (f324) registered ready_to_apply rows but added no control to begin them; each needed its own Start press.
site: Applications header + auto-apply route, web_ui.py + static/cockpit.js, 3 November 2026
symptom: After queueing several suggestions there was no way to begin them short of pressing Start on each row.
why_tests_missed: Queue tests stopped at registration; none asked how a queued row begins.
